listing.name: Luigi's Mansion (Luigi's Mansion Recompiled)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native local preparation; preserve in-app updater and setup ownership boundaries. Repository renamed from luigis-mansion-pc-port; old robfozz64 account appears in upstream notes, not in Portcove baseline. Limits: Released1.1.4 native local-preparation route; optional two-player mode unfinished. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux archives with bundled local compiler/setup; selected package CPU architectures unknown in frozen research. Original data: Own USA GLME01 and/or Europe GLMP01 ISO/RVZ/extracted data; bundled compiler builds game during initial setup. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
